_comment: These are the unlockable 'Skills' shown on a character's profile and purchased through Progression. They are distinct from the 20 stat and skill CHECK rolls used for dice rolling, which live in rules.json.

skills.name: Second Wind
skills.description: A short burst of focus that steadies the body enough to keep fighting.

skills.name: Focused Strike
skills.description: A single attack thrown with full concentration behind it.

skills.name: Read the Room
skills.description: A standing edge when sizing up strangers and their intentions.

skills.name: Arcane Channel
skills.description: Draws directly on stored mana to force an effect through.

skills.name: Iron Stomach
skills.description: Years of rough travel built up a resistance most people never need.

skills.name: Shadow Step
skills.description: A brief, near-silent burst of movement through cover.

skills.name: Battlefield Command
skills.description: A shouted correction that pulls an ally back on script.

skills.name: Steel Nerves
skills.description: The kind of composure that only comes from having already survived worse.
